newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria's Stoyanov leads 1st round poll - official.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria's Stoyanov leads 1st round poll - official.

text.p: Bulgarian opposition candidate Petar Stoyanov won 43.92 percent of the votes in weekend presidential elections and a second round will be held on Sunday, the electoral commission said on Tuesday.
Final results given by a commission spokesman speaking on state radio showed Culture Minister Ivan Marazov, candidate of the governing Socialists, came second with 26.92 percent.
"None of the presidential candidate teams won more than half of the votes, therefore the commission announces that a second round will be held on November 3," the spokesman said.
Socialist Prime Minister Zhan Videnov said earlier he had no plans for changes in the cabinet or party leadership despite his party's poor showing.
